positive.prompt: Use $repository-bootstrap to initialize evidence-backed instructions after I copied .codex and AGENTS.md
Run the explicit repository bootstrap command for this new project
Resume repository bootstrap from its needs-input state

negative.prompt: Find the project's real build and test commands before planning this feature
Implement this feature end to end with approval gates and verification

evals.prompt: I copied the starter .codex directory and AGENTS.md into a new repository. Use $repository-bootstrap. The manifests establish the language and test command, but nothing states which of two applications is the production entry point.
evals.expected_output: The agent initializes or resumes bootstrap state, records the supported facts, marks the production entry point as unresolved, asks one focused question, sets needs-input, and does not infer or edit product files.
expectations: Requires explicit invocation and does not treat bootstrap as an automatic prerequisite
Records manifest-backed facts with project-relative evidence
Persists a focused production-entry-point question and reports needs-input
Does not finalize dependent architecture instructions or edit product files

evals.prompt: An ordinary feature request arrives in a repository whose instruction pages still contain starter placeholders. Do not invoke any command I did not request.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not run repository bootstrap automatically; it reports that explicit $repository-bootstrap is available and handles or pauses the feature workflow according to the evidence required for that request.
expectations: Does not rewrite repository instructions as a side effect of feature work
Makes the explicit bootstrap option visible without treating it as authorized

evals.prompt: Earlier in this same task I invoked $repository-bootstrap, and the agent paused with one question about the production entry point. I now answer only: apps/api is the production entry point. Continue.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the answer as continuation of the already-authorized bootstrap, records it as user-confirmed evidence, resumes discovery and writing without requesting another invocation, runs the checked-in validators, and marks complete only from current passing receipts.
expectations: Does not require or request another $repository-bootstrap invocation in the same task
Preserves prior valid evidence and closes only the answered question
Records the production entry point as user-confirmed rather than repository-confirmed
Requires executed validator receipts before complete

evals.prompt: The previous repository bootstrap task was closed while state remained needs-input. This is a new task and I only provide the missing architecture answer without invoking repository bootstrap.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not resume the explicit-only bootstrap in a new task from the answer alone; it asks the user to invoke $repository-bootstrap to resume the saved state.
expectations: Distinguishes same-task continuation from a new-task resume
Does not mutate bootstrap state or repository instructions without a new explicit invocation
Requests one explicit resume invocation rather than discarding the saved state
